## About
California Auto Repair has been fixing cars in this city long enough to call itself a San Francisco institution. We work on all cars from Acura to Volvo, and we use only the best parts we can get.
Our head mechanic, Lincoln Ching, is certified by the National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence. When he isn't at the shop, he's spending time with his family or working on his classic car collection.
Our job is to keep you and your loved ones safe on the road. We're rated 4.3 on Google from 40 reviews, and we'd be glad to take a look at your car.

## Services
- Maintenance package: Regular service keeps your car running well. Our package covers oil and filter replacement, an exterior lights inspection, windshield wiper fluid, tire pressure adjustment and more.
- Weird noises: Car making weird noises or not driving like it used to? Bring it in and our mechanics will diagnose the problem and recommend a solution.
- Tires: Worn out or badly mounted tires hurt your gas mileage and safety. We'll make sure yours are in good shape.
- Brakes: Brakes are easy to overlook until they cost you. Let us check that yours work properly.
- Custom jobs: Need something extra? We've handled engine rebuilds, drive train installations and more. Drop us a line.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open Monday through Friday?
A: Yes, Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: You'll find us at 6027 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94121.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All cars, from Acura to Volvo.
